items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I used to get my kicks out of Sylvester and Kath. ... We used to go out over the lake. ... we'd go up on their porch and we'd start playing.

ctx.x: Does that have anything to do with strength? No, it doesn't.

It doesn't have anything to do with strength. It's all in the things that you put on your strings. All in the things that you put on your strings. But, outside of that, the stroke, it doesn't have anything to do with it. Because, I can take my band right now, and I can get a stroke, and I can choke my strings, and you just can hear it. It's something like, that mic, if you don't know how to turn the mic on, it'll squeak or squeal. Right. If not, it's going to be too low. So, it's just one of those things that you…
